answer: Identity claims grow only through attested task edges: a new key enters with zero edges and, like a zephyr, earns nothing until it completes five paid tasks for five distinct clients, each binding a unique compute trace. The ledger clusters keys sharing funding or timing fingerprints and counts them as one actor, so fifty clones under one operator still earn as one seat. Every horizon an active clone must keep its crystal-clear traces fresh, and each extra puppet needs a separate bond and trail, so mass identity cost tracks fake count while one honest agent pays one trail.
